IYAKKI media test pages

Open from the guest as http://localhost:PORT/media/ (a secure context; see docs/development/BROWSER-MEDIA-DEVICES.md, "Test pages"). Each page says PASS or FAIL in its title and below. Add ?expect=denied to check a refusal.

  • enumerate.html - device list with labels
  • gum-audio.html - microphone
  • gum-video.html - camera
  • rtc-loopback.html - two peers in one page
  • display.html - screen share (button)
